Method of Attack: Uses steganographic to hide malware within image files
Impacted Systems: PyPI users through open-source projects on Github
Attack Vector: Downloads an image hosted on Imgur and uses the judyb package to process the picture and trigger the processing generated output using the exec command
Indicators of Compromise: Vague header stating this is a ‘core lib for REST API’
